title: DIVIDE ( 4, 2 ) is a decimal number, 2.0

source.quote: The result is always decimal, unless a currency is divided by an integer or by a decimal; in this case, the result is currency.
source.supports: the result type of / and of DIVIDE

derivation: 4 / 2 = 2. DIVIDE of two integers returns a decimal number, as / does: 2.0.
